summary: Release acceptance is blocked. The reviewed commit is clean with respect to tracked files, but it is two commits ahead of its configured upstream, has no release tag, lacks a commit-bound validation receipt, and has no completed superseding audit gate or decision. The claim registry also retains an obsolete mask-width limitation that contradicts the current signal-profile-FWHM production semantics. The checkpoint hash and archived RC6 evidence are recoverable, and the validation report appropriately states that its earlier replay no longer represents the current pipeline.

evidence: `git rev-parse HEAD` returned `681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f`.
`git branch --show-current` returned `feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet`.
`git remote -v` identified origin as `https://github.com/dushyant-mishra/Drosophila-sperm-nuclei-segmentation.git`.
`git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{upstream}` returned `origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet`.
`git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{upstream}` returned `2 0`.
`git status --short --branch` reported the branch `[ahead 2]` and only the active untracked `audits/runs/20260917-v571-production-superseding-rc2/` directory.
`git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r 681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f` showed only `AGENT_CHANNEL.md` and append-only artifacts for the blocked rc1 audit launch.

`git diff --name-status origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet..HEAD` showed only `AGENT_CHANNEL.md` plus rc1 claim snapshot, manifest, gate summary, and prompts; no production source, profile, checkpoint, or test changes occur in the two unpublished commits.
`git diff --check` and `git diff --cached --check` produced no errors.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:30-32 names the epoch003 checkpoint, production-candidate role, and SHA-256 `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`.
`certutil -hashfile model_checkpoints\v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt SHA256` returned the same digest.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/provenance/acceptance_provenance_manifest.json:3-4 names the same checkpoint path and digest.
The production pipeline, tuner, bridge, profile, checkpoint, validation report, and RC6 receipt are all tracked according to `git ls-files`.

audits/claims_registry.json:64-67 says `Body width is apparent mask width`, while audits/V5_7_1_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md:44-53 says mask width cannot carry a genotype comparison and defines primary width as background-corrected signal-profile FWHM.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:143-167 likewise marks mask-contour width as superseded and defines signal-profile FWHM as the primary comparative width.
The rc2 claim_snapshot.json reproduces the obsolete mask-width limitation, so the audit input and current production documentation do not describe the same scientific behavior.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:3 binds its receipt to production commit `6f9e73b170db121460ab82f28542d1ed1e8f96bb`, not reviewed commit 681a5f3.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:17-27 records 237 tests, tuner self-check, provenance validation, and diff checking for the older RC6 state.
`git diff --name-status 6f9e73b..681a5f3` shows subsequent modifications to the production pipeline, tuner, validation report, design ledger, claim registry, and numerous tests.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:190-201 reports 448 tests as of 2026-09-15 but provides no commit-bound immutable receipt for 681a5f3.

The focused exact-commit command `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` could not start because the managed read-only environment had no usable temporary directory; pytest raised `FileNotFoundError: No usable temporary directory found`.
audits/runs/20260917-v571-production-superseding-rc2/manifest.json identifies the correct claim, reviewed commit, branch, clean launch state, and acceptance_candidate mode.
The same manifest has `completed_at_utc: null` and an empty `role_exit_codes` object.
No `gate_summary.json` or `decision.json` exists in the rc2 run directory.

audits/claims_registry.json:7 still labels the claim accepted while its latest recorded audit is the older 20260827 remediation run, despite V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:212-217 stating that later behavior changes require a superseding audit.
`git tag --points-at HEAD` returned no tag for reviewed commit 681a5f3.
`git cat-file -t` showed existing v5.7.0 and v5.7.1-rc1 through rc3 tags are annotated tag objects.
Those tags peel respectively to de2ffd1, 6c6de52, 4b66a87, and 5bb5a83; none identifies the reviewed commit.
No final v5.7.1 release tag exists for the current candidate.
`git ls-files audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/**` identified 76 tracked evidence files totaling 29,237,112 bytes.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:34-51 records hashes for the retained manifests, replay archive, reports, and consistency artifacts.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:59-70 explicitly limits segmentation/tracking evidence to the content-identical RC6 production blobs and separately binds the rebuilt report package.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:212-220 correctly warns that the old replay no longer represents the changed pipeline and cannot support biological conclusions.
`git status --short --ignored` showed expected ignored environments, caches, private configuration, tuning outputs, probability caches, generated analysis data, and audit logs.
`.gitignore:2` excludes `gemini_api_key.txt`; the local key file appeared as ignored rather than tracked.
The required 4,634,914-byte production checkpoint is deliberately tracked, and its digest matches the profile and provenance manifest.
Ignored scratch enumeration emitted permission-denied warnings for several historical pytest directories, so exhaustive size ranking was not possible.

A focused `git grep` for API-key, client-secret, password, and access-token labels found only code that loads the ignored Gemini key or environment variable; no literal credential value was identified.
`.gitignore:2` explicitly excludes `gemini_api_key.txt`, and `git status --short --ignored` confirmed the local file is ignored.
This was a focused working-tree scan, not a complete history or entropy scan.
`git for-each-ref refs/heads refs/remotes` showed local `audit-v571-post-remediation` at 8c1f9f5 and `feature/v5.7.1-body-width` at 1600a39 without upstreams, both older than the active candidate.
The configured remote feature branch is at dfefa26, while the active branch is at 681a5f3 and ahead by two commits.
The old branches do not contain or replace reviewed commit 681a5f3; they should be documented as historical/integrated rather than silently treated as release heads.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:203-217 states that the earlier decision is historical, a fresh seven-role audit is required, later behavior changed, and the production gate is closed.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:219-220 states that no biological conclusion may rest on the report's numbers.
README.md:67 describes the v5.7.1 GUI as a production candidate rather than an accepted final release.

findings.title: The reviewed commit is not published to its configured upstream
findings.impact: The exact candidate cannot currently be recovered from the configured remote branch, so Git does not yet provide the required durable release identity.
evidence: `git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{upstream}` returned `2 0`.
`git branch -a --contains 681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f` listed only the local feature branch.
The upstream ref remains at dfefa26 while HEAD is 681a5f3.
findings.recommendation: After the audit gate passes and explicit publication authorization is provided, push the exact accepted commit and verify the remote object directly.

findings.title: No completed superseding audit gate or decision exists
findings.impact: The current accepted registry state predates material measurement, merge-handling, count, reporting, and workflow changes; release acceptance cannot rely on the older decision.
evidence: audits/runs/20260917-v571-production-superseding-rc2/manifest.json has no completion timestamp or role exit codes.
The rc2 directory has no gate_summary.json or decision.json.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:212-217 explicitly says the production claim requires a superseding run.
audits/claims_registry.json:7 still records the claim as accepted from the earlier audit state.
findings.recommendation: Complete all required independent rc2 reviews, validate the run, archive its gate summary and append-only decision, and update the registry only if the superseding gate passes.

findings.title: Validation is not durably bound to reviewed commit 681a5f3
findings.impact: There is no immutable proof that the current production code, expanded tests, profile, documentation, and audit tooling passed together on the reviewed commit.
evidence: audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:3 binds the archived receipt to 6f9e73b.
`git diff --name-status 6f9e73b..681a5f3` includes changes to production code, tuner, documentation, registry, and tests.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:190-201 reports a later test count without a commit-bound receipt.
The current review's pytest attempt could not collect because no writable temporary directory was available.
findings.recommendation: From an unchanged clean checkout of 681a5f3, run the documented full test suite with an explicit writable `--basetemp`, compilation, tuner self-check, provenance validators, and diff check; archive exact commands, environment, commit, results, and relevant hashes.

findings.title: Claim snapshot misstates the current primary-width semantics
findings.impact: The release claim and its audit input identify apparent mask width as the limitation, while the current production design and report use signal-profile FWHM. Reviewers and future users could validate or interpret the wrong measurement contract.
evidence: audits/claims_registry.json:64-67 contains the mask-width limitation.
audits/V5_7_1_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md:44-53 rejects mask width for genotype comparison and defines signal-profile FWHM as primary.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:143-167 records the same supersession.
audits/runs/20260917-v571-production-superseding-rc2/claim_snapshot.json contains the stale limitation.
findings.recommendation: Correct the claim registry's known limitation to describe apparent signal-profile FWHM and its non-absolute, non-PSF-corrected interpretation, then start a new superseding audit so every reviewer receives the corrected immutable snapshot.

findings.title: No annotated release tag identifies the reviewed candidate
findings.impact: There is no immutable named release pointer tying reviewed commit 681a5f3 to its eventual audit decision and evidence archive.
evidence: `git tag --points-at HEAD` returned no tag.
Existing annotated v5.7.1 candidate tags peel only to earlier commits 6c6de52, 4b66a87, and 5bb5a83.
No final v5.7.1 tag was found.
findings.recommendation: Only after a passing gate and explicit authorization, create and publish an annotated final tag that identifies the accepted commit and references the immutable audit/evidence manifest.

findings.title: Historical local side branches have no upstream designation
findings.impact: The old audit and body-width branches may confuse future provenance review even though they do not alter the current candidate.
evidence: `git for-each-ref` showed `audit-v571-post-remediation` at 8c1f9f5 and `feature/v5.7.1-body-width` at 1600a39 with no upstreams.
Both branches substantially predate the active candidate at 681a5f3.
findings.recommendation: Document them as historical or integrated branches. Do not delete or rewrite them without explicit authorization.

limitations: No other reviewers' outputs were intentionally inspected or used.
No full image stack or expensive image inference was run.
Pytest could not start in the managed read-only environment because no writable temporary directory was available.
Remote synchronization was assessed from configured local remote-tracking refs without a network fetch.
Permission-denied ignored scratch directories prevented exhaustive enumeration and size ranking of every local generated artifact.
The secret check was a focused tracked-working-tree scan and did not include complete Git history or entropy analysis.
The rc2 gate cannot be evaluated until every required review exists.
recommended_follow_up: Correct the stale primary-width limitation and launch a new immutable superseding audit snapshot.
Create a commit-bound validation receipt for the exact replacement candidate using the validated project virtual environment and a writable explicit temporary directory.
Complete all seven required reviews and archive a passing gate summary and decision before changing claim acceptance state.
After gate passage and explicit authorization, publish the accepted commit and create an annotated final release tag.
Retain the existing RC6 evidence as historical immutable evidence, while clearly separating it from validation of the changed current pipeline.
